name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport was somewhat accidental. Armed with a business degree and a natural talent for organization, he initially worked in the corporate sector. However, a chance encounter with a former racing driver at a networking event sparked an unexpected passion. Intrigued by the high-pressure environment and the critical role of human capital, he pivoted his career towards motorsport, joining MP Motorsport five years ago.

Kenji's approach to HR is centered on creating a supportive and performance-driven environment. He believes in fostering strong relationships with every member of the team, from mechanics to drivers, ensuring their needs are met and their voices are heard. He's particularly adept at conflict resolution and talent acquisition, always seeking individuals who not only possess the necessary skills but also embody the team's values. What sets Kenji apart is his deep understanding of Japanese business philosophy, which emphasizes teamwork, continuous improvement (Kaizen), and respect for individuals.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Kenji is of average height with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Has a peculiar habit of adjusting his tie when under pressure.
Prefers to conduct informal check-ins with staff over a cup of green tea.
